buckets.name: job_application
buckets.description: Job applications, referrals, and recruiter inbound sent to careers@.
exemplars: I would like to apply for the open software engineer position
Please find my resume attached for your consideration
A colleague referred me to this opening and I'd love to interview

buckets.name: customer_support
buckets.description: Customer or vendor support requests, questions, and complaints.
exemplars: My order hasn't arrived and I need help tracking it
I'm having trouble logging into my account
This product isn't working as expected, can you assist

buckets.name: vendor_invoice
buckets.description: Vendor invoices, billing, and payment-related correspondence.
exemplars: Please find attached invoice for services rendered last month
Following up on outstanding payment for our latest shipment
Requesting confirmation that the wire transfer was received

buckets.name: internal_routine
buckets.description: Routine internal staff traffic with no urgency.
exemplars: Reminder that the team meeting is moved to 3pm tomorrow
Sharing this week's status update, nothing needs action
FYI the office will be closed for the holiday

buckets.name: internal_escalation
buckets.description: Internal traffic requiring immediate attention: complaints about a specific person, urgent operational issues, or anything time-sensitive.
exemplars: I need to report a serious issue with my manager immediately
This is time-sensitive and needs leadership attention right away
Escalating this workplace conduct concern for urgent review
